About this item

  • Cold All Day Long: Our insulated water bottle keeps drinks cold for up to 24 hours. Double-wall stainless steel, zero condensation, just fresh hydration, wherever you go
  • Sip or Chug, Your Choice: Straw lid for sipping on the go and twist cap for deep hydration, all in one ENCOOL water bottle
  • Multiple Sizes to Fit Your Routine: From quick workouts to all-day travel, this sports water bottle comes in sizes to suit your routine. Just choose the one that fits your lifestyle
  • Leakproof Water Bottle: This water bottle is made for active days, with a tight-sealing lid that prevents leaks on the go
  • Space‑Saving 180° Foldable Handle: Folds flat to tuck into backpacks, and flips up to follow your pace from morning commutes to spontaneous weekend escapes

Great Size and Keeps Drinks Cold
I've been using this water bottle for everyday use and have been really happy with it overall. It keeps my water cold, and the size is great without feeling overly bulky or difficult to carry around. I also haven't had any issues with leaking, which is important with a bottle like this. The straw works well most of the time, although I've noticed that it can occasionally be difficult to use. It's a minor inconvenience, but it's something I've experienced with the lid. Overall, I really like the size and insulation, and it's been a good everyday water bottle for me.

  • M. Westman
    5 out of 5 stars
    26 oz. Encool bottle: Keeps ice water very cold; very well designed. Very happy!
    Reviewed in the United States on July 28, 2025
    Size: 26 OuncesColor: Cotton Candy
    Verified Purchase
    Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
    Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

    I purchased this bottle hoping it would keep my water cold throughout each day as we traveled in hot environments in our car. So when I received this bottle, I did a "cold test" in my home. I totally filled the bottle with ice, then finished it off by filling the remaining spaces with water. The ice was still there that night. The next day (Day 2), I checked it in the morning: still a lot of ice. I checked it again that night (still a very large "clump" of ice). The following day (Day 3), I again checked in the morning to find there were still a few little ice cubes still floating in the bottle. WOW! When I will be traveling in a hot environment in our car for an upcoming trip, I expect the bottle to at least keep the ice and water cold throughout each day of travel. I will do the same thing every day of our trip to ensure I have something cold to sip. Good job, Encool! I am very pleased! So pleased that I immediately purchased a 2nd bottle for my husband! It feels like it is made of great quality. The handle is wide enough for my four fingers to grasp. Something I hadn't noticed is that the handle area closest to the bottle lid isn't just a 90-degree angle; it is made with a 45-degree angle at each side so your fingers rest more comfortably when holding the bottle. The lid has both the straw-sip and the chug options, and work great. I turned the full bottle on its side all night and there were no leaks. This may just be the perfect water bottle for us!

    Update after 1.5 weeks of hot environment travel: These water bottles were the only ones among our group of travelers that kept the water cold, They worked so well, we didn't even have to fill the entire bottle with ice and then fill the remaining spaces with water. Instead, we were able to put about 1/3 of the space as ice, and the rest as water. Still, by the end of the day, ice remained--even after drinking all the water. I ended up leaving the chug and straw features open through the day to try to melt the ice on the first few days before I began changing the ice to water ratio.

    We love these bottles. They are perfect for us!

    Also, the "boots" we purchased from Amazon fit perfectly and worked perfectly: https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0D7D4MYYK?ref=ppx_yo2ov_dt_b_fed_asin_title&th=1

    Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
    Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

    Awesome little bottle; just finished a vacation and it was the perfect size for staying hydrated throughout the day while not being too big to carry around. Amazing insulation, too! If I put ice water in this overnight, usually there will still be unmelted ice in it by morning. Cleans very easily and I really like the lid options; I use the twist-off cap for pouring electrolyte mix or flavor packets, while I use the small spout for drinking.

    After one month of use, it has one dent (shown in photo) but that’s from the bottle accidentally being dropped on a concrete floor. Thankfully it doesn’t affect how it sits or anything. This thing is still very durable without being heavy.

    The only issue I’d bring up (shown in photo) is that the plastic of the drinking spout is kind of rough on the edges of the hole. It almost cut my lip the first time I used this (I wasn’t very careful inspecting it the first time I used it), and I have to pull off tiny flecks of plastic from it once in a while to make sure I’m not drinking any of the flecks. Really not ideal, but I prefer a plastic spout to a rubber one that could break. Even so, I figured it was worth mentioning, especially since a water bottle this size is often purchased for kids to use. (Also! Be sure the drinking spout is empty before you close it; if you don’t, the spout will leak a tiny bit of water when moved.)

    Having said all this, I still really like this water bottle. I wanted something small but durable for travel that kept cold water cold, in a bottle without a lot of loud branding on it. This one is super sturdy, with amazing insulation, in a convenient size, and in a really lovely neutral color! Recommended, if you can look past the rough plastic bit. Be sure to inspect it before using it!

About this Item

  • Cold All Day Long: Our insulated water bottle keeps drinks cold for up to 24 hours. Double-wall stainless steel, zero condensation, just fresh hydration, wherever you go
  • Sip or Chug, Your Choice: Straw lid for sipping on the go and twist cap for deep hydration, all in one ENCOOL water bottle
  • Multiple Sizes to Fit Your Routine: From quick workouts to all-day travel, this sports water bottle comes in sizes to suit your routine. Just choose the one that fits your lifestyle
  • Leakproof Water Bottle: This water bottle is made for active days, with a tight-sealing lid that prevents leaks on the go
  • Space‑Saving 180° Foldable Handle: Folds flat to tuck into backpacks, and flips up to follow your pace from morning commutes to spontaneous weekend escapes

Product Description

Stay Cool, Stay Moving

This insulated water bottle is designed for everyday hydration—whether you're heading to work, school, the gym, or out exploring. With a leak-proof straw lid and sleek profile, it’s a stylish and practical choice for busy mornings and on-the-go routines.

Functional Style for Every Day

Made from durable stainless steel, this bottle keeps drinks cold for hours and fits comfortably in backpacks, totes, and car cup holders. Whether you're a student, a commuter, or just always on the move, it’s built to keep up—and look good doing it.

Key Features:

  • Convenient capacity for daily hydration
  • Leak-proof straw lid for easy sipping
  • Double-wall insulation keeps drinks cold
  • Compact size fits most cup holders and bags
  • Backed by a 1-year warranty for added peace of mind
